title: Fusion Reactor Simulator
description: A deterministic research and education simulator with reduced 0D power balance and 1.5D radial transport coupled to fixed-boundary Grad-Shafranov equilibrium. Includes error-controlled TR-BDF2, localised events, conservative remapping, exact rewind and opt-in pedestal, transport, impurity and fast-ion modules; browser UI, headless library, CLI and Python wrapper. Verified against analytic and manufactured solutions and benchmarked against published values, with validation where the data allow. Documents known reference misses and unmet convergence and predictive-model targets.
references: Bosch and Hale (1992), Improved formulas for fusion cross-sections and thermal reactivities. https://doi.org/10.1088/0029-5515/32/4/I07
ITER Physics Basis (1999), Chapter 2: Plasma confinement and transport. https://doi.org/10.1088/0029-5515/39/12/302
Sauter, Angioni and Lin-Liu (1999), Neoclassical conductivity and bootstrap current formulas. https://doi.org/10.1063/1.873240
Shimada et al. (2007), Chapter 1: Overview and summary. https://doi.org/10.1088/0029-5515/47/6/S01
notes: Developed by Mustafa Karatum with substantial assistance from AI coding assistants Claude Code (Anthropic), Codex (OpenAI) and MiMo under the author's direction and review. Automated and AI-assisted verification does not replace independent plasma-physics review.
